title: Care of Footpath
desc: An orphaned boy takes up a personal challenge to attend school and get educated. However, while trying to complete this goal, he faces numerous hardships on his way.

title: Shravana Banthu
desc: Kailash and Urvashi's relationship remains unfulfilled due to a tragedy in their past lives. Years later, Kailash's friend Vishwas tries to reunite the lovers in their present births.

title: Hello Guru Preethigoskara
desc: Two friends, Sanju and Anupama, fall in love with each other. However, they don't realise it, until it is too late and Anupama is set to marry someone else.

title: Bharjari
desc: Surya, an orphan raised by the best friend of his deceased mother, wants to become a soldier. He falls in love with a woman but soon gets an offer to join the army.

title: RRR
desc: A fearless revolutionary and an officer in the British force, both of whom once shared a deep bond, decide to join forces against despotic rulers.
